metadata.description: Claude plugins from AE5VG: amateur radio station control and serial consoles.

plugins.name: amateur-radio
plugins.description: Operate an amateur radio station with Claude: fldigi for PSK, RTTY and other digital modes, WSJT-X for FT8 and FT4, and N3FJP for logging.

plugins.name: serial-console-mcp
plugins.description: Let Claude work any device through its serial console: Juniper and Cisco gear, IoT gateways, instruments, microcontrollers, radios and rotators.
